name.en: Commercial building final inspection (112 Final) and Certificate of Occupancy
name.zh: 商业建筑最终验收（112 Final）及入住证

agency.en: City of Austin Development Services Department, Building Inspections
agency.zh: 奥斯汀市开发服务局建筑检查科

when.en: Last, after plumbing, electrical, mechanical, one-time (landscape, environmental, driveway) and fire inspections all pass. The CO is issued on a successful final for new construction or significant renovation.
when.zh: 最后一步，在管道、电气、机械、一次性检查（景观、环境、车道等）和消防检查全部通过之后。新建或大规模改造在最终验收通过后签发入住证。

book.en: Schedule in the Austin Build + Connect (AB+C) Portal under My Inspections (your account must be linked to the active, paid permit), or by phone through the IVR with your IVR PIN, 10-digit permit number and 3-digit inspection code.
book.zh: 在 Austin Build + Connect（AB+C）门户的“My Inspections”预约（账户须关联已生效且已付费的许可），或用 IVR PIN、10 位许可编号和 3 位检查代码通过自动语音系统电话预约。

lead.en: Usually performed 24 hours after scheduling; workload can push it to the next business day or 48 hours.
lead.zh: 通常在预约后 24 小时内检查；工作量大时可能推迟到下一个工作日或 48 小时后。

failNext.en: Correct every deficiency, then schedule a re-inspection; failed or partial inspections reappear in AB+C for rescheduling.
failNext.zh: 整改所有问题后预约复检；不合格或部分通过的检查会重新出现在 AB+C 中供再次预约。

item.en: Job address posted in a visible location
item.zh: 工地地址张贴在明显位置

item.en: Approved plans (paper or electronic) on site
item.zh: 现场备有批准图纸（纸质或电子）

item.en: All plumbing, electrical, mechanical, one-time and fire inspections passed before scheduling
item.zh: 预约前所有管道、电气、机械、一次性检查及消防检查均已通过

item.en: All special inspection letters (engineer, third party) uploaded before scheduling
item.zh: 预约前已上传所有专项检查函（工程师、第三方）

item.en: Required exits and exit access doors in place; door capacity sufficient for the occupant load
item.zh: 所需出口和出口通道门均已到位；门的通行能力满足人数荷载

item.en: Sign at each exit door: THIS DOOR TO REMAIN UNLOCKED WHEN THIS SPACE IS OCCUPIED, 1-inch letters
item.zh: 每个出口门张贴“本空间有人时此门须保持不上锁”标识，字高 1 英寸

item.en: Group A spaces with 50+ occupants: doors have no latch or lock other than panic or fire exit hardware
item.zh: 50 人以上的 A 类（集会）空间：门除逃生推杆外不得有插销或门锁

item.en: Restroom and shower floors smooth, hard and nonabsorbent, carried up the wall at the junction
item.zh: 卫生间和淋浴间地面光滑、坚硬、不吸水，并在墙地交接处向上延伸

item.en: All work finished at the time of the final
item.zh: 最终验收时所有工程已完工

item.en: Nothing moved in before the CO or TCO except items permanently affixed and shown on the approved plans
item.zh: 取得 CO 或临时 CO 之前，除批准图纸上标明的固定设施外，不得搬入任何物品

name.en: AFD Fire Final (inspection 609), with TCO Stocking and TCO Occupancy
name.zh: AFD 消防最终验收（609 号检查），含临时入住证（备货/入住）检查

agency.en: Austin Fire Department, Fire Marshal's Office
agency.zh: 奥斯汀消防局消防局长办公室

when.en: After all MEP inspections pass and before the 112 Building Final. Kitchen hood suppression must be approved before TCO Stocking.
when.zh: 所有机电管道检查通过后、112 建筑最终验收之前。厨房排烟罩灭火系统须在临时备货检查前获批。

book.en: Call the AFD scheduling office at 512-974-0153, option 3 (8 a.m.–1 p.m. weekdays; leave a voicemail with your permit number), or submit the online Inspection Scheduling Request Intake Form. Fees are paid in advance through the AB+C portal.
book.zh: 致电 AFD 预约办公室 512-974-0153 转 3（工作日上午 8 点至下午 1 点；请留言并说明许可编号），或提交在线检查预约申请表。费用须提前在 AB+C 门户支付。

failNext.en: TCO inspections count as Fire Final inspections; any later Fire Final inspection is charged a re-inspection fee. TCO and Fire Final are held until The Compliance Engine records are current.
failNext.zh: 临时入住证检查即算作消防最终验收；之后再做的消防最终验收需付复检费。在 The Compliance Engine 记录更新前，临时入住证和消防最终验收都会暂缓。

item.en: Type I hood suppression inspected and approved, Class K extinguisher installed, report uploaded
item.zh: I 类排烟罩灭火系统已检查批准，已配 K 类灭火器并上传报告

item.en: Acceptance test reports for new fire protection systems (hood suppression, sprinklers, alarm) uploaded to The Compliance Engine and accepted by AFD
item.zh: 新消防系统（排烟罩灭火、喷淋、报警）的验收测试报告已上传至 The Compliance Engine 并被 AFD 接受

item.en: Fire extinguishers installed (ABC, dry chemical and/or Class K as appropriate)
item.zh: 已安装灭火器（按需配 ABC、干粉和/或 K 类）

item.en: Building address and suite number installed
item.zh: 已安装建筑地址和单元号

item.en: Sprinkler and alarm systems complete, tested, tagged and in service
item.zh: 喷淋和报警系统完工、测试、挂签并投入使用

item.en: Emergency lighting and exit signs installed and approved; egress paths clear; panic hardware where required
item.zh: 应急照明和出口指示已安装并获批；疏散通道畅通；需要处装逃生推杆

item.en: All MEP permits closed and construction complete, space clean and tenant ready
item.zh: 所有机电管道许可已结案，施工完毕，空间清洁可交付使用

item.en: Knox box installed where required, 4–6 feet above ground near the main fire access
item.zh: 需要时在主要消防入口附近离地 4–6 英尺处安装 Knox 钥匙箱

item.en: Fire alarm panel, gas meters, electrical shutoffs and riser room labeled
item.zh: 火灾报警主机、燃气表、电源总闸和喷淋立管间均有标识

item.en: CO2 detection for beverage systems tested and approved, where applicable
item.zh: 如有饮料二氧化碳系统，其泄漏检测已测试并获批

item.en: For a tenant finish-out, the shell building already has its Fire Final
item.zh: 租户装修项目：所在毛坯楼已取得消防最终验收

name.zh: 奥斯汀公共卫生局开业前检查

agency.en: Austin Public Health, Environmental Health Services Division
agency.zh: 奥斯汀公共卫生局环境卫生服务处

when.en: Required for new construction, remodels and changes of ownership, before the Certificate of Occupancy and operating permit. You must pass before the permit is issued and you can operate.
when.zh: 新建、改造和所有权变更均须进行，在入住证和经营许可之前。通过后才会发许可、才能营业。

book.en: Submit the Pre-Opening Inspection Application (with your Operational Permit application) online in the My Health Department portal, by email to EHSD.Service@austintexas.gov, in person at 1520 Rutherford Ln, Bldg. 1, Ste 205, or by mail. Fees are paid before the inspection; an inspector then contacts you to schedule.
book.zh: 通过 My Health Department 门户在线提交开业前检查申请（连同经营许可申请），或发邮件至 EHSD.Service@austintexas.gov、到 1520 Rutherford Ln 1 号楼 205 室递交，或邮寄。检查前须付费，之后检查员会联系你约时间。

lead.en: APH recommends applying about a month before your planned opening; an inspector contacts you within three business days of a complete application.
lead.zh: 卫生局建议在计划开业前约一个月申请；材料齐全后检查员会在三个工作日内联系你。

feeNote.en: $178 per inspection in the City of Austin and contracted cities (none in unincorporated Travis County); $173 extra outside normal hours.
feeNote.zh: 奥斯汀市及签约城市每次 178 美元（特拉维斯县非建制区免费）；非工作时间另加 173 美元。

failNext.en: You must bring the facility up to code before the operating permit is approved; the $178 pre-opening fee is charged per inspection. Operating without approval can bring legal charges.
failNext.zh: 须整改达标后才批准经营许可；178 美元的开业前检查费按次收取。未经批准营业可能被起诉。

item.en: Built or remodeled according to the approved plans, all equipment installed and working
item.zh: 按批准图纸建造或改造，所有设备已安装并能正常使用

item.en: All refrigeration holds food at or below 41°F
item.zh: 所有冷藏设备能将食品保持在 41°F 或以下

item.en: Hand sinks at prep, dispensing, warewashing and ice wait stations with 100°F hot and cold water, soap, paper towels and a handwashing sign
item.zh: 加工、出餐、洗碗及取冰服务台设有洗手池，提供 100°F 热水和冷水、洗手液、纸巾并张贴洗手标识

item.en: 12-inch splash guard or 18 inches of separation between a hand sink and food, ice or clean surfaces
item.zh: 洗手池与食品、冰或洁净台面之间设 12 英寸挡水板或相隔 18 英寸

item.en: Dish machine dispenses chemical sanitizer or a 180°F final rinse, with test strips; or a 3-compartment sink with two drain boards
item.zh: 洗碗机投放化学消毒剂或末次冲洗达 180°F，并备试纸；或使用带两个沥水板的三格水槽

item.en: Food prep sinks, ware sinks, ice bins and ice machines drained through an air gap; hose bibs have backflow preventers
item.zh: 食品加工池、洗碗池、冰柜和制冰机经空气隔断排水；带螺纹的水龙头装防回流器

item.en: Service, mop or curbed floor sink with a mop drying rack
item.zh: 设有拖把池或围堰地面水槽，并配拖把晾干架

item.en: Smooth, cleanable ceilings over food, ice, warewashing, bars and restrooms; no open rafters or exposed ducts or pipes
item.zh: 食品、冰、洗碗区、吧台和洗手间上方天花板平滑易清洁；无外露椽子、风管或管道

item.en: Wall/floor junctures caulked with no more than a 1/32-inch gap; baseboards installed; raw brick or concrete sealed
item.zh: 墙地交接处打胶，缝隙不超过 1/32 英寸；装踢脚线；裸砖或混凝土已密封

item.en: Exterior doors self-closing and tight; window and door screens at least 1/16-inch mesh; exhaust fans screened or self-closing louvers
item.zh: 外门自闭且严密；门窗纱网至少 1/16 英寸网眼；排风扇装纱网或自闭百叶

item.en: Dumpster and grease barrel on a concrete or asphalt pad, with tight lids and drain plugs
item.zh: 垃圾箱和废油桶放在混凝土或沥青地坪上，盖子严密、排水塞到位

item.en: 50 foot-candles where staff prepare food, 20 at self-service and produce areas
item.zh: 员工加工食品处 50 尺烛光，自助区和生鲜区 20 尺烛光

item.en: Restrooms with 100°F hand sink, mechanical ventilation and self-closing doors, not opening into the kitchen
item.zh: 洗手间有 100°F 洗手池、机械通风和自闭门，且不直通厨房

item.en: City of Austin Certified Food Manager certificate posted
item.zh: 张贴奥斯汀市认证食品经理证书

name.zh: AFD 维护性（年度）消防检查

agency.en: Austin Fire Department, Fire Marshal's Office
agency.zh: 奥斯汀消防局消防局长办公室

when.en: After opening; many commercial and retail spaces receive regular fire and life-safety inspections, and fire protection systems need annual third-party inspections (hoods every six months).
when.zh: 开业后；许多商业和零售场所会定期接受消防和生命安全检查，消防系统须每年由第三方检查（排烟罩每半年一次）。

book.en: AFD schedules maintenance inspections; see AFD's Types of Inspections page. Contractors upload system inspection and deficiency reports to The Compliance Engine.
book.zh: 维护检查由 AFD 安排，详见 AFD“检查类型”页面。系统检查及缺陷报告由承包商上传至 The Compliance Engine。

item.en: Approved address posted and visible from the street
item.zh: 批准的地址已张贴且从街上可见

item.en: Fire lanes marked; hydrants and fire department access unobstructed
item.zh: 消防车道有标线；消火栓和消防通道无阻挡

item.en: Right size, type and number of extinguishers, mounted and serviced within the past 12 months
item.zh: 灭火器规格、类型、数量正确，已安装并在过去 12 个月内维护

item.en: Exits not blocked or locked; no storage in the means of egress
item.zh: 出口不得阻挡或上锁；疏散通道不放杂物

item.en: Exit signs illuminated and emergency lighting working
item.zh: 出口指示灯常亮，应急照明正常

item.en: Clearance around electrical panels; no extension cords as permanent wiring or piggybacked
item.zh: 配电箱周围留足空间；不得用延长线代替永久布线或串接

item.en: Combustible waste and soiled rags in approved metal containers
item.zh: 可燃垃圾和油污抹布放在合格的金属容器中

item.en: Compressed gas cylinders stored and used properly
item.zh: 压缩气瓶存放和使用规范

item.en: Occupant load card posted near the main entrance of assembly spaces and not exceeded
item.zh: 集会场所主入口附近张贴人数荷载卡，且不超员

item.en: Drapes, curtains and decorations treated for fire resistance
item.zh: 帷幔、窗帘和装饰物经阻燃处理

item.en: Range hood suppression serviced semi-annually by a licensed fire protection company; reports in The Compliance Engine
item.zh: 排烟罩灭火系统每半年由持牌消防公司维护；报告已录入 The Compliance Engine

item.en: Fire alarm and sprinklers tested on schedule by state-licensed companies and kept in working order
item.zh: 火灾报警和喷淋按期由州持牌公司测试并保持正常

why.en: IFC 901.2; AFD Fire Protection Criterion Manual 3.2.10

name.zh: 常规食品场所检查（计分）

agency.en: Austin Public Health, Environmental Health Services Division
agency.zh: 奥斯汀公共卫生局环境卫生服务处

book.en: Not booked; Environmental Health Officers arrive unannounced.
book.zh: 无需预约，环境卫生官员不预先通知上门。

scoring.en: Scored on APH's 56-item Retail Food Establishment Inspection Report under the Texas Food Establishment Rules and City Code; scores from the last three years are published on the City's open data portal. Post your permit in the front window or on the outside front wall within 5 feet of the door.
scoring.zh: 按德州食品场所规则和市法规，用卫生局 56 项零售食品场所检查表打分；近三年的分数公布在市政府开放数据平台。经营许可须张贴在前窗或门外前墙上，距门 5 英尺以内。

failNext.en: Below 70: re-inspection fee ($134) and a scored follow-up in 10 days. A second sub-70 within 36 months adds a criminal complaint; a third suspends the permit and closes you; a fourth starts revocation. Below 50 on any inspection: immediate 48-hour closure.
failNext.zh: 低于 70 分：收复检费（134 美元），10 天后计分复查。36 个月内第二次低于 70 分将被提起刑事控告；第三次暂停许可并停业；第四次启动吊销程序。任何一次低于 50 分：立即停业 48 小时。

item.en: Person in charge present, knowledgeable and performing duties; permit posted
item.zh: 负责人在场、熟悉规定并履行职责；张贴经营许可

item.en: Certified Food Manager certificate presented; all food employees completed food handler training within 60 days of hire
item.zh: 能出示认证食品经理证书；所有食品从业员工在入职 60 天内完成食品处理员培训

item.en: Employee illness reporting, exclusion rules and a vomiting/diarrhea clean-up procedure in place
item.zh: 有员工疾病报告、禁止上岗规定以及呕吐/腹泻清理程序

item.en: Hands washed properly; no bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat food; hand sinks supplied and accessible
item.zh: 正确洗手；不徒手接触即食食品；洗手池用品齐全且可随时使用

item.en: Proper cooking, reheating, cooling, hot holding and cold holding temperatures
item.zh: 烹饪、复热、冷却、热保温和冷保存温度正确

item.en: Ready-to-eat TCS food date-marked and discarded on time; time-as-control procedures and records if used
item.zh: 即食的需温控食品标注日期并按时丢弃；如采用以时间为控制，须有程序和记录

item.en: Food from approved sources, received at proper temperature, in good condition
item.zh: 食品来源合格，接收时温度正确、状态良好

item.en: Food separated and protected; food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized
item.zh: 食品分开存放并加以保护；食品接触面清洁消毒

item.en: Toxic substances identified, stored and used properly
item.zh: 有毒物品标识、存放和使用规范

item.en: Accurate thermometers provided
item.zh: 配备准确的温度计

item.en: No insects, rodents or animals
item.zh: 无昆虫、鼠类或动物

item.en: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used, with test strips
item.zh: 洗碗设施安装、维护和使用得当，并备有试纸

item.en: Hot and cold water at adequate pressure; proper backflow devices; sewage properly disposed
item.zh: 冷热水压力充足；防回流装置合格；污水处理得当
